The main takeaway from our work is that

the BBMN23 strain possesses a complete set of genes for the biosynthesis of the main cell-wall components, including teichoic acid, peptidoglycan, and lipopolysaccharide, which are the main factors in bacterial survival and persistence in the host gut.
BBMN23 possesses a unique genomic feature, the presence of a prophage-like region, that is absent in other Bifidobacterial strains.

the genome size of BBMN23, which is the largest among B. adolescents strains, is associated with the presence of many genes involved in carbohydrate metabolism and stress response, which may play an important role in the adaptation of BBMN23 to the adult gut.
